lignes.texte: Finally, an app made for taxis. Not against them.
Hamid has been a taxi driver for twenty years. Hours spent looking for customers, and too often, empty seats.
What if all that changed?
Ride-hailing apps use private cars and take a commission on every ride. Bab Taxi is the opposite: only official taxis, and zero commission on the meter.
His taxi is recent, clean and well kept: it's the first thing passengers notice.
Hamid goes on duty with a single tap, whenever he decides.
Requests come along his route. He accepts or declines. The first to accept gets the ride: nobody can steal it from him.
He keeps his favourite navigation app, Waze or Google Maps. Bab Taxi alerts him with a notification, and he answers without taking his eyes off the road.
On arrival, a reminder: hazard lights on, stop safely.
The passenger is on board: Hamid starts the ride himself. And the meter fare is all his.
On shared rides, his empty seats fill up, with a passenger counter at every stop.
Heading home? With “My destination”, he only gets passengers going his way.
A customer wants the taxi to himself? The seats he blocks are paid to the driver. And the best drivers move up to Premium, with an extra on every ride.
Cash or card: what's paid by card lands in his wallet right away, tips included.
In the back, a screen shows ads linked to the route. A share of the revenue goes to Hamid, without changing anything about his driving.
Every evening, “My earnings” shows him what Bab Taxi adds: card tips, his share of advertising, fuel saved.
And at the end of the month, a quality bonus rewards the rating of all his rides.
More income, fewer empty kilometres… and more time with his family.
Bab Taxi, the taxi app. Drivers, join us from day one in Casablanca.
No unknown cars: with Bab Taxi, only official taxis, verified drivers with a checked criminal record, and the meter price shown before you get in.
Modernise the Moroccan taxi, rather than let it be replaced.
Casablanca. Every morning, thousands of red taxis hit the road.
Bab Taxi only works with licensed taxis. The sector modernises within its legal framework, with traceable activity, instead of giving way to private cars.
On Bab Taxi, every taxi is registered: verified driver, criminal record checked, licence number, identified vehicle.
Recent, clean taxis, drivers verified down to their criminal record and rated by passengers: the image of the taxi changes, and visitors feel reassured.
The Ministries of the Interior and of Transport can follow activity in real time, with anonymised data, in compliance with Law 09-08.
Complaints followed up, incidents traced, SOS alerts: safer transport for everyone.
Fewer empty kilometres, more passengers per car: less congestion, less pollution.
Digital payments, quality service, access for all: the image of a modern Morocco, open to the world.
